descriptions.zh-Hans: 在釜山吃过小麦冷面后写的卡片。只有一句“慢慢吃完的一碗”，旁边留着小碗画。
descriptions.en: My card after milmyeon in Busan: “a bowl I took my time over,” with a small bowl drawn beside the words.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在釜山吃猪肉汤饭后留下的菜单，弯弯的汤匙柄像在问“还记得这一碗吗”。
descriptions.en: A menu from dwaeji gukbap in Busan, with a spoon handle asking, “Remember this bowl?”

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在釜山广安里等到同行人后画的邮包和浪。两样小记号，收好一场顺利的碰面。
descriptions.en: A mailbag and wave drawn after meeting a companion at Gwangalli in Busan. Two signs for finding each other.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在釜山吃汤饭后画的汤匙，柄弯得像问号。我决定留下，让它问问今天的味道。
descriptions.en: A spoon from after a rice-soup meal in Busan. Its handle curved into a question mark, which I decided to keep.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在釜山太宗台听浪后写的几句话，每句后留着长长的空隙，像等着海再响一次。
descriptions.en: Notes from listening to waves at Taejongdae in Busan. Long spaces let each sentence wait for the sea’s next turn.

names.en: A Little Ring of Sea Light

descriptions.zh-Hans: 把广安里等人时的亮光和远桥留进自制卡片。邮包和浪折在里面，打开才一起露面。
descriptions.en: My handmade card recalls light on Gwangalli’s water and the distant bridge. A mailbag and wave wait together inside.
